identification: Unsigned old oil on canvas, young woman in a bonnet before a tree, in the manner of George Morland (1763-1804). Attribution rests only on an owner's inscription on the frame back ('Advertised & sold to me as painted by George Morland, British') plus a conservator's cleaning note (Tasmania). Likely circle of, follower or later copy. Old keyed stretcher; later gilt composition frame.

viewing_check: Photograph the front under raking light and UV if possible for signature/monogram, retouching and the paint handling (loose and fluent vs hesitant copy); check canvas weave and any relining, tacks, stencils, labels or old exhibition/dealer labels on the stretcher; photograph the full frame-back inscription and conservator note; ask whether any receipt or provenance exists.
